findings.title: Use the actual after-state when a valid observation window has no frames
findings.mechanism: At169 the immediate after-state is emitted and discarded. last_state starts empty at172 and is assigned only inside window_frames loop. Valid window_seconds=0 skips loop, so in_update_at_end becomes0 and done1 yields landed_all=true. Original child-killed inserts the killed segment in UPDATE before returning; no frame has run, so this is a false completion/landing claim. The new explicit-edge mock already returns in_update=1 at op1 after-state, but its zero-window test asserts only calls/no-frame and ignores summary.
findings.bounded_correction: Capture the immediate after-state, emit it and retain it as initial last_state. Require a valid actual state before deriving completion; do not equate absent state with no pending segments. Extend existing zero-window caller test to assert actual pending1/landedfalse and add a truthful completed-state positive. Keep raw state/events and original physical behavior unchanged.
